provenance.coverage: Three new modules checked on held-out corpora, ratings and seeds; expected values come from an independent Python implementation of the specification.
provenance.derivation: Private civic-assistant app PR #224 (blind rating harness: evaluative-field stripping enforced on the produced object, seeded shuffle, metrics that expose misses and wrong reasons beyond an m-of-n count, and a corpus audit that found government items carry no subject matter) re-synthesized as a sanitized TypeScript specification, synthetic corpus and held-out data. No private code, items, ratings or names are included. v2 (MB-010c follow-up, native admission finding): the specification required rejecting any own evaluative key, but the oracle (Object.entries) and checks inspect only own enumerable string keys; the specification now says so. Oracle and hidden checks are unchanged.
provenance.historical_exposure: Private history; synthetic fixture has low recognition risk.
provenance.limitations: No model trial, representative-day coverage, native isolation, or contamination-free claim.
